newsitem.title: UK: Shell says return on capital up to 13.2 p.
newsitem.headline: Shell says return on capital up to 13.2 p.

text.p: Royal Dutch/Shell Group said on Thursday its return on capital rose sharply in the final quarter of 1996 for an average for the year of 13.2 percent compared to 10.6 percent in 1995.
Presenting annual results, Shell said return on capital rose from 10.6 percent in the 12 months to September 30 last year.
Shell said capital expenditure last year rose three percent to 7.8 billion stg with increases in exploration and production and in marketing partially offset by a reduction in refining.
The company said cash holdings at the end of the year amounted to 7.3 billion stg, similar to those at the end of 1995.
Total debt was 7.0 billion stg and the total debt to equity ratio 15.1 percent.
